title: How I Analyze a Flip (full $$ walkthrough)
description:
Apply To Work With Me Directly → https://go.valueaddinvestinggroup.com/1a26e872

In this video, I walk you through a current flip deal and break down exactly how I analyze investment properties.

We cover:
 • The major items to look for when walking a property
 • How to estimate holding costs, closing costs, and profit margins
 • How I calculate whether a deal works or not
 • The first steps to flipping your first property — even with limited experience

Whether you’re just getting started or already flipping houses, this full walkthrough breaks down the real numbers and the real strategy I use on every deal.
